title: chrome.storage.local.set silently fails in offscreen documents
trigger: Debug logging or state persistence via chrome.storage.local in offscreen document — data never appears
principle: chrome.storage.local.set() in offscreen documents can silently fail without throwing or rejecting. The Promise resolves but data doesn't persist. For debug logging from offscreen, use chrome.runtime.sendMessage to background (which CAN write to chrome.storage.local) instead of writing directly.

cases.context: Offscreen document tries to write debug state to chrome.storage.local for content script to read — data is always undefined

applyFor: Debug logging from Chrome extension offscreen documents
Any chrome.storage.local usage in offscreen documents
Diagnosing 'data is undefined' issues in extension offscreen contexts
